meta.description: Physics calibration (#19): two gaps sized by tools/physics/plan_jumps.py. Full gas, no steering. Jump 1 should clear the gap with ~29 m to spare, jump 2 with only ~10 m. Save the replay; tools/ghost_probe measures the real landing points.
